method_choice.reason: PypKa 2.10.0 installs but delphi4py ships no cp312 extension modules; not reproducible on project Python 3.12. Selected before any target scoring.

method.name: PROPKA3 side-chain pKa → Henderson–Hasselbalch net charge titration Q(pH)

propka_paper.title: PROPKA3: Consistent Treatment of Internal and Surface Residues in Empirical pKa Predictions

pypka_paper_not_used.title: PypKa: A Flexible Python Module for Poisson–Boltzmann-Based pKa Calculations

termini_policy.qc_only: full_Fv_with_termini Q(pH) retained for QC, not canonical predictors
termini_policy.rationale: isolated VH/VL C-termini are artificial relative to Fab

charge_model.disulfide_sentinel: exclude CYS with pKa>=99.0 (PROPKA disulfide sentinel; consistent with PKA technical correction)

feature_definitions.charge_transition_width: pH width where |dQ/dpH| >= 0.5 * max_abs_dQ_dpH (contiguous max span)
feature_definitions.number_of_major_switch_regions: count of contiguous grid segments where |dQ/dpH| >= 0.5 * max_abs_dQ_dpH

anti_posthoc: Do not retune pH grid/thresholds after targets; any change => TITRATION-SHAPE_v2_POSTHOC
